Fight it to unlock this entry

zh_TW: 拖出去放塔,或者撳一下再撳地圖
en: Drag out to place, or tap then tap the map

zh_TW: 箭塔以穩定節奏鎖定射程圈內最近的單一敵人放箭,是可靠的基礎輸出。強化暴擊與雙重射擊後,單體爆發顯著提升。
en: The Arrow Tower looses shafts at a steady rhythm, always picking the nearest enemy inside its ring — dependable, unglamorous damage. Invest in crits and double shots and its single-target burst climbs sharply.

zh_TW: 拋物線範圍爆炸,攻速慢
加農砲台拋射砲彈,落點造成範圍爆炸傷害,適合清理成群小怪。攻速較慢,講求預判落點;破甲與擊退進一步強化控場。
en: The Cannon Battery lobs shells that detonate where they land, shredding tight packs of small enemies. It reloads slowly, so placement and lead matter; armor pierce and knockback turn it into a control piece.

zh_TW: 雷電塔射出閃電,在鄰近敵人之間連鎖跳躍,每跳一次傷害衰減。密集路段可同時削弱多個目標;提升連鎖數與降低衰減後覆蓋更廣。
en: The Thunder Spire throws a bolt that leaps from body to body, weakening with every hop. On a crowded stretch of road it grinds down several enemies at once; more chains and less falloff widen its reach.

zh_TW: 火球塔直射火焰,命中後附加持續燃燒傷害,對高血量目標尤其有效。燃燒可延長時間;爆燃機率觸發時瞬間引爆剩餘燃燒。
en: The Fireball Tower hurls flame straight ahead and leaves the target burning — brutal against anything with a deep health pool. Burns can be stretched longer, and a detonation roll blows the remaining burn all at once.

zh_TW: 冰霜塔攻擊附帶減速,令敵人更久停留在火網內;命中有機率完全冰凍目標。減速幅度與冰凍率是它的控場核心。
en: Every frost shard slows what it touches, holding enemies inside your kill zone far longer; some hits freeze the target outright. Slow power and freeze chance are the heart of its control.

zh_TW: 毒液塔疊加毒層造成持續傷害,並無視敵人護甲;毒層越高傷害越猛。敵人死亡時毒素向周圍擴散,引發連環中毒。
en: The Venom Tower layers poison stacks that eat through health regardless of armor — the deeper the stack, the faster it kills. When a poisoned enemy dies the toxin bursts outward and infects its neighbours.

zh_TW: 狙擊塔擁有全場最遠射程,優先狙擊高血量目標並打出高額單發傷害。血量低於處決線可被即殺;貫穿讓子彈洞穿多個目標。
en: The Sniper Nest reaches further than anything else on the field and always picks the healthiest target for a single crushing shot. Anything below the execute threshold dies instantly, and pierce sends the round through the rank behind it.
Fire rate climbs while locked on

zh_TW: 機槍塔持續鎖定同一目標時攻速不斷攀升,越打越快;切換目標會重置熱度。是對付單一厚血敵人的利器。
en: Hold the Gatling Tower on one target and its barrels spin ever faster — the longer it fires, the harder it hits. Switching targets dumps all that heat, so it excels against a single armored bruiser.

zh_TW: 迫擊砲超遠程曲射,對落點大範圍轟炸,但有最小射程死角。彈片分裂可波及更多敵人;燒灼地面造成殘留傷害。
en: The Siege Mortar arcs shells across almost the whole map and saturates the impact zone — but it cannot hit anything standing too close. Shrapnel widens the spread; scorched ground keeps burning after the blast.

zh_TW: 持續光束,鎖定愈久愈痛
en: A sustained beam that keeps ramping

zh_TW: 光束塔發射持續光束,鎖定同一目標越久傷害越高。融甲讓後續傷害穿透護甲;雙光束可同時照射兩個目標。
en: The Beam Tower pours an unbroken lance of light into its target, and the damage climbs the longer it holds. Armor melt strips protection as it burns; a twin beam splits the assault across two enemies.

zh_TW: 緩速力場塔本身不造成傷害,以光環大幅減速範圍內所有敵人;脆弱效果令其受到額外傷害。可強化為對 boss 同樣有效。
en: The Slowing Field deals no damage of its own; instead its aura drags every enemy inside it to a crawl and leaves them vulnerable to extra damage. Upgraded far enough, it bites into bosses just as hard.

zh_TW: 鍊金塔不攻擊,定期自動產出金幣,是經濟核心。範圍內擊殺可獲得額外賞金,開場更提供一筆啟動資金。
en: The Alchemy Tower never fires a shot — it simply turns time into gold, and it is the backbone of your economy. Kills inside its circle pay a bounty, and it hands you a lump of starting capital the moment the wave begins.
Sends soldiers to block the road

zh_TW: 兵營塔派出士兵駐守路面,以肉身阻擋敵人前進並近身纏鬥;士兵陣亡後定期重生。增兵與護甲讓防線更穩固。
en: The Barracks Tower posts soldiers on the road itself, stopping the advance with their bodies and tying enemies up in melee; the fallen are replaced on a timer. More bodies and heavier armor make the wall hold.

zh_TW: 來回穿透打沿途所有怪
迴旋鏢塔擲出迴旋鏢,去程與回程都會貫穿路徑上所有敵人。回程可附加額外傷害;多鏢齊發覆蓋更廣路段。
en: The Boomerang Tower throws a blade that cuts through every enemy on its way out and again on its way home. The return pass can be sharpened further, and extra blades blanket a longer stretch of road.

zh_TW: 對鄰近路段持續傷害(飛行無效)
en: Constant damage to nearby road (not fliers)

zh_TW: 荊棘塔對鄰近路段持續造成傷害,但對飛行敵人無效;流血可疊加。對重型敵人有額外加成,是近戰路段的穩定消耗。
en: The Bramble Tower rips at anything walking the road beside it — but thorns cannot reach what flies. Bleed stacks pile up, and heavy enemies take extra punishment, making it a steady grinder on close-quarters lanes.

zh_TW: 超遠程追蹤導彈,專剋 boss 同大型
導彈塔以全場第二遠的射程發射追蹤導彈,飛彈全程鎖定目標。對 boss 與大型敵人有巨幅加成,是點名首領的專職武器;但爆炸範圍細,清雜兵海遠不如加農砲台與迫擊砲。
en: With the second-longest reach on the field, the Missile Tower launches warheads that track their mark all the way in. Against bosses and heavy units the bonus damage is enormous — this is the tower you build to name a target. Its blast is tiny, though, so it clears a swarm far worse than a Cannon Battery or Siege Mortar.

zh_TW: 常駐詛咒光環:圈內敵人受傷加深、死亡多掉金
en: Hex aura: more damage taken, more gold dropped

zh_TW: 詛咒塔不攻擊,以常駐光環籠罩路段:圈內敵人(含 boss)受到的傷害大幅加深,走出光環後仍殘留片刻。被詛咒者陣亡時額外掉金,所以它同時是放大器與經濟塔 —— 但必須擺在已有輸出塔的位置。多座光環的放大不疊加(取最高)。
en: The Curse Tower never attacks. It drapes a standing hex over a stretch of road: everything inside it — bosses included — takes markedly more damage, and the mark lingers for a moment after they walk out. Cursed enemies drop extra gold when they die, so it is amplifier and economy in one — but only where damage towers already stand. Overlapping auras do not stack; the strongest one wins.

zh_TW: 聖光塔造成聖屬傷害,並以光環提升周圍友方塔的攻速;淨化可移除敵人增益。是輔助與輸出兼備的核心塔。
en: The Radiance Tower burns with holy damage while its aura quickens every friendly tower around it; purify strips buffs off the enemy. Support and firepower in the same emplacement.

zh_TW: 磁力塔週期性釋放脈衝,將範圍內敵人擊退拉回,延緩其推進;擊退後附帶減速。對重型敵人亦有一定效果。
en: The Magnet Tower fires a pulse on a cycle, dragging everything in range backwards and stalling the advance; the shove leaves them slowed. Even heavy units feel some of the pull.

zh_TW: 傳送塔有機率將敵人傳送回後方路段,大幅拖延其行程;傳送後可附帶暈眩。對同一目標的傳送次數設有上限。
en: The Warp Tower may snatch an enemy and drop it back down the road, wiping out much of its progress; the arrival can leave it stunned. Any single target can only be sent back so many times.
Massive damage at a chosen point

zh_TW: 在指定位置召喚隕石,對大範圍造成瞬間傷害,最適合砸向密集的敵群。
en: Calls a burning rock down on a spot you choose, flattening a wide circle in an instant — best dropped straight onto a packed crowd.
Bolts strike at random across the field

zh_TW: 全場隨機落下多道閃電,每道造成單體傷害;落雷數越多,清場越快。
en: Bolts hammer down all over the map, each one striking a single enemy; the more bolts fall, the faster the field clears.
Freezes every enemy on the map

zh_TW: 凍結全場敵人一段時間,解凍後仍殘留減速,是危急時的保命大招。
en: Locks every enemy in ice for a spell, and they stay sluggish after the thaw — the button you press when the line is about to break.

zh_TW: 在指定區域釋放毒瘴,持續對範圍內敵人造成每秒毒傷。
en: Releases a cloud of venom over the chosen ground, eating away at everything that stands or walks in it.

zh_TW: 在路面召喚民兵堵路,以肉身拖住敵人推進的節奏。
en: Calls up militia in the middle of the road to buy you time with their bodies.

zh_TW: 立即獲得一筆金幣,持續期間擊殺敵人還可額外生財。
en: Hands you a purse of gold on the spot, and for a while afterwards every kill pays a little extra.

zh_TW: 扭曲時間,令全場敵人大幅減速一段時間。
en: Bends time around the battlefield, dragging every enemy to a crawl for a while.

zh_TW: 鼓舞全軍,短時間內所有塔的攻速一同提升。
en: A roar down the line — for a short burst every tower you own fires noticeably faster.

zh_TW: 為基地張開結界,可抵擋數次入侵,並附帶反傷。
en: Raises a ward over the keep that swallows a few breaches outright, and burns whatever runs into it.
Blows enemies back down the road

zh_TW: 沿路捲起龍捲風,將途經的敵人一併推回後方。
en: Tears a whirlwind along the road, hurling everything it passes back the way it came.
% max-HP damage to all ground enemies

zh_TW: 地震撼動全場,對地面敵人造成當前生命值百分比傷害,對 boss 造成固定重傷。
en: The ground heaves across the whole map, tearing a percentage of health from every enemy on foot and landing a heavy fixed blow on the boss.
Sets a stretch of road ablaze

zh_TW: 在指定路段生成火牆,對經過的敵人持續灼燒。
en: Raises a curtain of fire across the road; anything that walks through it keeps burning.

zh_TW: 點選單一目標巨大傷害
對單一目標降下天雷造成巨大傷害,對 boss 有額外加成。
en: Calls down a pillar of judgement on one chosen enemy — devastating on anything, and it bites even deeper into a boss.

zh_TW: 在指定範圍釋放磁暴,暈眩其中所有敵人。
en: Detonates a magnetic storm over the target zone, leaving everything inside it stunned.
Pins enemies at a chosen point

zh_TW: 在指定位置製造黑洞,吸住並持續傷害範圍內的敵人。
en: Tears open a singularity that holds enemies in place and grinds them down while it lasts.

zh_TW: 普通雜兵,無特殊能力,慣以數量取勝。
en: Rank-and-file rabble with no special tricks — they win by sheer numbers.

zh_TW: 首領技:定期召喚小哥布林增援。
en: Boss skill: summons goblin reinforcements at regular intervals.

zh_TW: 移動極快的野獸,血量偏低但難以攔截。
en: Fast-moving beasts — thin-skinned, but very hard to pin down.

zh_TW: 暴怒:受擊後短暫狂暴,移速大增。
en: Frenzy: after taking a hit it goes berserk and its speed spikes.

zh_TW: 陣亡後有機會原地復活一次;略帶魔抗。
en: May claw its way back up once after falling; carries some magic resistance.

zh_TW: 亡靈光環:周圍骷髏最多可復活兩次,第二次只回復一半生命。
en: Undead Aura: nearby skeletons rise up to twice, the second time at half health.

zh_TW: 高護甲重甲兵,大幅減免物理傷害,移動緩慢。
en: Heavily armored and slow, shrugging off most physical damage.

zh_TW: 石化:定期進入短暫無敵狀態。
en: Petrify: periodically turns to solid stone and becomes untouchable.

zh_TW: 週期虛化,虛化期間無法被鎖定;高魔抗。
en: Phases out on a cycle and cannot be targeted while it does; high magic resistance.

zh_TW: 疾影:虛化時移動速度更快。
en: Swiftshade: moves far faster while phased.

zh_TW: 飛行單位,無視地面陷阱與近戰堵路。
en: Airborne — ignores ground hazards and anything blocking the road.
Dive: periodically accelerates into a sudden lunge.

zh_TW: 持續自我回復生命,消耗戰極為棘手。
en: Regenerates constantly — a nightmare in a war of attrition.

zh_TW: 扎根:低血時定身詠唱回復,詠唱期間受到的傷害會抵銷回復量,暈眩可直接打斷。
en: Take Root: at low health it roots and channels a heal — damage dealt during the cast cancels it point for point, and a stun breaks it outright.

zh_TW: 硬殼:單次所受傷害有上限,懼怕持續傷害。
en: Hard Shell: caps the damage of any single hit — but it fears damage over time.

zh_TW: 堅甲反震:受到的傷害整體降低。
光環:持續治療並加速周圍同伴。
en: Aura: continuously heals and hastens everything around it.

zh_TW: 群療:定期治療全場敵人。
en: Mass Heal: periodically heals every enemy on the field.

zh_TW: 陣亡時分裂成兩隻較小的史萊姆。
en: Splits into two smaller slimes when killed.

zh_TW: 增殖:定期分裂出小史萊姆。
en: Proliferate: keeps spawning smaller slimes on a timer.
